scoring_justification: The efficiency is the primary scored result (T0 threshold_or_better against paper gold); the generation rate and JV curve are structurally audited because no hidden ground-truth labels exist for them and their purpose is to confirm the pipeline was run correctly.

outputs.description: 1D electron-hole-pair generation rate; audited for non‑negativity and monotonic decrease in z.
JV curve; audited for monotonic decrease of J with Vext and consistency with the maximum power point.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing solar cell efficiency in percent.

outputs.description: Solar cell efficiency; scored against a hidden gold value (≥ threshold earns full credit).

output_contract.notes: All outputs are generated by a single evaluation of the optimal design under AM1.5G illumination. The hidden gold for efficiency is the paper-reported value; generation_rate.csv and jv_curve.csv are checked structurally.
